target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, virtio-ramfb, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, NEC USB keyboard/tablet plus VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_TEST_DISK=build/tothefront-current-instrumented.img ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tothefront-current-move-fire-usb-2026-11-10.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --usb-input nec --usb-with-virtio --probe-tothefront-fire-diag
verified: Launched ToTheFront, selected Human for both players, generated a map, dismissed help, selected Artillery, plotted an adjacent order, and advanced phases.
The disposable Human.ZC fixture reported one legal infantry move; the real graphical drag moved unit 0 from cell (40,4) to (38,4).
The disposable fixture placed a live opponent in an adjacent cell and reported both player 0 and player 1 completing the actual direct-fire input path.
Escape returned to the terminal, 40+2 returned 42, and zstatus reported failed=0.
limitations: Movement and direct fire used a disposable, instrumented Human.ZC fixture that chooses/reports legal targets; this does not establish natural full-match or AI behavior.
This headless QEMU run uses UTM's bundled framework; it is not a visible UTM app or Pi hardware test.
